ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized to punctate scars and edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of contiguous low-intensity dark pixels. Sparse, high-contrast white focal spots are distributed across the central and right lobe regions. High-intensity pixels also define the peripheral boundaries and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical depth comprising 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys 2-5 pixels deep) along the entire continuous trailing edge; more irregular and jagged on the distal portion of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the cranial edges of both lobes, tapering to acute, narrow points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, particularly dense on the medial and distal sections of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light gray on black) oriented horizontally across the left lobe and diagonally across the central-right ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive punctate scarring and linear rake-like marks across the ventral surface; distinct jagged erosion of the left lobe tip.
